title: AOK budget tree
description: Budget tree document (plan §3⑥). Every delegation belongs to one tree, and the hub's own cost counts toward the tree cap. Admission check before create_session: spent + child cap <= cap_usd, depth <= max_depth, running children < max_concurrent. Defaults come from aok/budget.yaml (decision D3, [추론] values). Running totals (spent_usd, status) are kept in the ledger `trees` collection (ledger.schema.json#/$defs/trees).

tree_id.description: Tree identifier; also used as the `tree:<tree_id>` session tag.

hub_session.description: Session id of the hub that owns the tree. Replaced on hub rotation.

cap_usd.description: Tree cap in USD (list price), including the hub's own cost.

soft.description: Soft threshold as a fraction of cap_usd; crossing it raises a warning alert (feature ②).

max_depth.description: Maximum delegation depth below the hub (1 = children only, no grandchildren).

max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of children running at the same time.

on_overrun.description: Action when the cap is reached: notify = alert the user only (default, quality first); interrupt = the hub may call interrupt_session.

hub_rotate.description: Hub rotation thresholds: on reaching either, the hub writes HANDOFF and moves to a new hub session.

context_tokens.description: Hub context size (tokens) that triggers rotation.

hub_cost_usd.description: Hub cumulative cost (USD) that triggers rotation.

model.description: Model the child runs on; null or absent means inherited from the caller. Changing a model needs an explicit user request (D8).

cap_usd.description: Child cap in USD (default ceiling 15, per-role caps in aok/budget.yaml).

spent_usd.description: Child spend in USD as last read from get_session.
